evals.name: pop-song-gflat-for-adult-beginner
evals.prompt: 我朋友学钢琴一年左右，大概英皇一级的水平。这是《Sand Between Our Fingers》的钢琴谱（sand-between-our-fingers.musicxml），原版太难了，帮我改一个她能弹下来的版本。
evals.expected_output: A new two-hand score at about Grade 1: one-accidental key (moved from G-flat and said so), RH single-line melody, LH slow single notes, eighths or longer, whole song form kept, plus a short Chinese reply.

evals.name: bach-prelude-16th-arpeggios
evals.prompt: My daughter just passed her ABRSM Grade 1 piano and she loves Bach's Prelude in C (the first one from the Well-Tempered Clavier). Can you make a version of it she could actually play? The score is attached (bach-prelude-c.musicxml).
evals.expected_output: A new score in C at about Grade 1 that keeps the bar-by-bar harmony of the prelude without sixteenths, plus a short English reply that does not call it an exam piece.

evals.name: mozart-k545-alberti-for-teaching
evals.prompt: 把莫扎特 C 大调奏鸣曲 K.545 第一乐章呈示部开头这段（mozart-k545-exposition.musicxml）改成约英皇一级的难度，下周给学生上课用。
evals.expected_output: A new score in C at about Grade 1: Alberti bass reduced to slow single notes, RH scale runs simplified to eighths, plus a short Chinese reply.

evals.name: minuet-already-close
evals.prompt: Is this Minuet in G (minuet-in-g.musicxml) OK for a grade 1 student? If it isn't, make it grade 1 but don't change more than you need to.
evals.expected_output: Recognises the minuet is already close to Grade 1, changes only the few spots over the line (stray three-note chords, extra voices), keeps G major and the melody, and explains briefly.
